description: This file implements the Queue class and its related components for a network simulation, including packet acceptance, dequeuing, aggregation, and alarm handling within the quic::simulator namespace.

classes.name: Queue
classes.description: Represents a network packet queue with aggregation and alarm capabilities in a network simulator.

classes.name: Queue::AggregationAlarmDelegate
classes.description: Handles alarm events for queue aggregation timeout.

classes.name: Queue::EnqueuedPacket
classes.description: Data structure for packets enqueued in the Queue with associated bundle number.

classes.name: Queue::ListenerInterface
classes.description: Interface for listening to queue events such as packet dequeuing.

methods.name: Queue::AcceptPacket
methods.description: Accepts a packet into the queue, handling capacity and aggregation.

methods.name: Queue::Act
methods.description: Processes the queue, dequeuing packets if the port is available.

methods.name: Queue::EnableAggregation
methods.description: Enables packet aggregation with specified threshold and timeout.

methods.name: Queue::NextBundle
methods.description: Advances to the next aggregation bundle.

methods.name: Queue::ScheduleNextPacketDequeue
methods.description: Schedules the next packet dequeue operation based on port availability.

methods.name: Queue::AggregationAlarmDelegate::OnAlarm
methods.description: Handles alarm trigger to process aggregation timeout.

methods.name: Queue::EnqueuedPacket::EnqueuedPacket
methods.description: Constructor for enqueued packet with bundle number.
